name: button-group
purpose: A labelled role=group of related native buttons, visually attached (shared borders) or spaced, horizontal or vertical. Composes Button; keyboard interaction stays native (Tab through every button).
whenToUse: A small set of related actions that belong together, such as Previous / Next or Copy / Paste.
Grouping buttons so assistive technologies announce their shared purpose.
whenNotToUse: Choosing one or several options: use Radio Group, Checkbox Group, or a segmented control.
Large sets of commands with arrow-key navigation: use Toolbar (planned).
Navigation between pages or views: use links or Tabs.
responsive: Spaced horizontal groups (attached: false) wrap at narrow widths. Attached horizontal groups never wrap (that would break the shared borders); they scroll horizontally within max-inline-size 100%. Vertical groups stack.
rtl: Logical properties: shared borders and removed radii follow the inline direction, so the first button has the start radii in both directions.
theme: Inherits Button tokens; adds only spacing, border-width, and the focus ring. Forced-colors mode draws a Highlight focus outline.
security: Button text and labels are rendered with textContent. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: Unit-tested with up to 3 buttons; intended for small groups (2 to 7 buttons).

limitations: Not a toolbar: there is no arrow-key roving focus. A Toolbar component is planned for that pattern.
Attached horizontal groups scroll instead of wrapping at narrow widths; buttons at the end may be off-screen until scrolled.
enhance() only considers direct child <button> elements.
unsupported: Toggle (pressed) state management; set aria-pressed on the buttons yourself.
antiPatterns: Very long attached groups that force horizontal scrolling; use attached: false so they wrap.
